nodes.label: graphify Reference: Query, Path, Explain
nodes.rationale: Constrained query expansion against the actual graph vocabulary is required before traversal because the matcher has no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language matching; tokens must be picked only from the extracted vocab to avoid fabricated searches. Answers are saved back via save-result with an --outcome to close a self-improving feedback loop.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Coherent flow spanning the graphify skill references: detect, transcribe, extract, merge, cluster, query/path/explain, incremental update, and git-hook/CLAUDE.md integration, all operating on graphify-out/graph.json.
